== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 5 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Thomas Caspersen (5 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 1]], [[Virtual Block 3]], [[Virtual Block 4]] and [[Virtual Set 0]], sets dated 2009–2014 on this wiki. The events named in the concept credits date from 2005 to 2007. The concept credits also name the event or award the concept came from: Norwegian Open 2007 (1 card); Norwegian Open 07 (1 card); Norwegian Nationals 2006 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Thomas Caspersen|Card Credits]].
